caseName: Kansas City Motion Picture Machine Operators v. Hughes
caseNameFull: Kansas City Motion Picture Machine Operators, etc. v. John E. Hughes, etc.
summary: Error to the Supreme Court of the State of Missouri.
attorneys: Mr. William J. Hughes, Mr. Frank P. Walsh and Mr. Joseph W. Folk, for plaintiffs in error, submitted., Mr. Charles M. Miller, with whom Mr. J. W. Dana was on the brief, for defendants in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for the want of jurisdiction. Section 237 of the Judicial Code, as amended by the Act of September 6, 1916, c. 448, § 2, 39 Stat. 726; Jett Bros. Distilling Co. v. Carrollton, 252 U. S. 1, 5-6.
